content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: deflection plus overtime on both queues lifts service level to 82% (target 80%) for 08:15-15:30 at ₹16,122.","why":"General has 9 unplanned absences against a usual 2.4. It is down to 51 agents against 57.6 expected, and demand and handle time are on plan. Doing nothing is predicted to give 55.4% over the disruption window (general 45.8%) with 10.8% abandons. R1 is the cheapest policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target. It predicts 82.0% overall, with payments at 83.4% and general at 80.2%. Abandons fall to 3.7% and the rest-of-day figure is 87.0%. It uses 20% chat deflection on both queues, cancels all coaching 09:00-12:00, offers overtime to 10 general agents 09:00-15:00 and offers overtime to 6 payments agents 11:00-15:00.","trade_offs":["P4 (₹11,802) and P2 (₹12,258) are about ₹4,000 cheaper but fall short at 77.5% and 76.0%. General would stay below target at 77.0% and 74.0%.","R2 reaches 85.0% with general at 82.8% and 2.9% abandons, but costs ₹18,372, about ₹2,250 more than R1.","P1 adds no overtime (₹450) and actually predicts slightly worse than doing nothing, at 54.2%.","General is only just over target at 80.2%, so R1 has little margin if overtime take-up is short."],"watch":"Check overtime acceptance on general first. R1 needs all 10 agents in each block to hold general above 80%. Also watch payments absence: it is 6 against a usual 2.6, which could put its cover at risk. Re-check once more intervals of data arrive, because only one interval has been seen so far."}
